answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and as a result paying the fable bond on all of them and exposing each to the falcon slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 12 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the pulse audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
